UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION
Form 10-K
Apple Inc.
For the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024
CIK 0000320193

Item 1. Business
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and sells a variety of related services.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis
Net sales for 2024 were $391,035 million, compared to $383,285 million in 2023.
iPhone net sales were $201,183 million in 2024, compared to $200,583 million in 2023.
Services net sales were $96,169 million in 2024, compared to $85,200 million in 2023, an increase of 12.9%.
Gross margin was $180,683 million, or 46.2% of net sales.

Item 8. Financial Statements
Consolidated Statements of Operations (in millions, except per-share data)
Net sales                                                2024        2023
Products                                               294,866     298,085
Services                                                96,169      85,200
Total net sales                                        391,035     383,285
Gross margin                                           180,683     169,148
Operating income                                       123,216     114,301
Net income                                              93,736      96,995
Cash generated by operating activities was $118,254 million in 2024.
